issue_request: FHIR-6154 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Conformance issue asking whether Conformance needed a RevInclude list analogous to Conformance.rest.resource.searchInclude, with the accepted resolution to add it and define summary fields to address Conformance size.
initial_application: No current branch commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-6154, but git pickaxe found 834aec288aa703bdc17b2413d816a50074005122 on 2015-07-31 adding searchRevInclude to the Conformance spreadsheet and generated parser/model support. That matches the Jira comment saying the work was already done. Later summary-field coverage was refined in historical Conformance commits such as 5799ef64bb7f35e5dba624e345dbf545c8f6628a and df618ea3cf8af170a33004a7674d1bec8ded749a before the resource was renamed/refactored to CapabilityStatement.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is an active build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml defines CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchRevInclude and contains isSummary flags plus summarization guidance. A 2019 Zulip conformance thread discusses use of searchRevInclude and no searched Confluence/Zulip evidence conflicted with the source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed; editing current source would duplicate existing semantics rather than fix a missing requirement.
